title: Praise the Name of the Lord

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise him in the what?
Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his what?
Praise him, sun and moon, praise him, all you shining what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:3 (ESV): "praise him, all you shining stars!"

questions.question: Praise him, you highest heavens, and you waters above the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:4 (ESV): "and you waters above the heavens!"

questions.question: Let them praise the name of the Lord! For he commanded and they were what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:5 (ESV): "For he commanded and they were created."

questions.question: And he established them forever and ever; he gave a decree, and it shall not pass what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:6 (ESV): "and it shall not pass away."

questions.question: Praise the Lord from the earth, you great sea creatures and all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:7 (ESV): "you great sea creatures and all deeps,"

questions.question: Fire and hail, snow and mist, stormy wind fulfilling his what?
Mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all what?
Beasts and all livestock, creeping things and flying what?
Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:11 (ESV): "princes and all rulers of the earth!"

questions.question: Young men and maidens together, old men and what?
Let them praise the name of the Lord, for his name alone is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:13 (ESV): "for his name alone is exalted;"

questions.question: His majesty is above earth and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:13 (ESV): "his majesty is above earth and heaven."

questions.question: He has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his saints, for the people of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 148:14 (ESV): "for the people of Israel who are near to him."

key_verse_text: Let them praise the name of the Lord, for his name alone is exalted; his majesty is above earth and heaven.
